_comment: Media catalog for music recommendation (plan D8). Read by assistant/music.py.
Each track: id (stable, used in actions and in /media/<id>.mp3), title, artist, genre,
energy 1-5 (1 calm, 5 very energetic), kid_safe (true = ok with a child on board),
file (mp3 in assistant/data/media/, gitignored - share the files outside git), source URL, license.
Disengagement (D) proposals use energy >= music.min_energy_for_disengagement (assistant.yaml, default 4):
with this catalog that means pop1, rock1, rock2.
